pipeline.modality: Oral / IV small molecule — triterpenoid glucan synthase inhibitor (fungerp)

indications.indication: Severe / drug-resistant invasive fungal infections (Candida, Aspergillus, Pneumocystis, Coccidioides, Histoplasma, Blastomyces, mucorales)
indications.trial_design: Phase 1 in healthy subjects; SAD 50–900 mg, MAD 50–300 mg QD x 7 days; n=88
indications.trial_status: Ongoing — SAD/MAD portions completed; food-effect cohort and IV development continuing. FDA Qualified Infectious Disease Product (QIDP) and Fast Track designations granted Jan 21, 2026

commercial_product.indication: Vulvovaginal candidiasis (VVC) and reduction in incidence of recurrent VVC
commercial_product.status: FDA-approved 2021 (VVC) / 2022 (rVVC); licensed to GSK May 2023 (excluding greater China) — partner-owned commercialization
